name: jwt_recognizer
note: JSON Web Token: base64url header starting with eyJ ('{"'), '.', payload, optional '.signature'. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/jwt.py. Two fixes vs. the original: its classes [A-Za-z0-9-_=] contain the range 9-_ (which admits :;<=>?@[\]^), and its signature part was lazy (*?) and therefore never matched; here the signature is included so it is redacted. The original's base64/JSON decoding check is not reproduced.
